sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, American officials conceded what's become increasingly clear from investigative reporting by The Times
sentences.zh: 周三，美国官员承认了一件事，这通过《时报》的调查报道已经变得越来越清晰：

sentences.en: that the United States military was responsible for the airstrike that destroyed an elementary school in Iran, killing at least 175 people, most of them small children.
sentences.zh: 美国军方对摧毁伊朗一所小学的空袭负有责任，造成至少175人死亡，其中大多数是幼小的儿童。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Maliki Brown and Julian Barnes on what led to one of the most devastating military errors in decades.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事马利基·布朗和朱利安·巴恩斯将带我们了解导致数十年来最惨重军事失误之一的原因。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月12日，星期四。

sentences.en: Maliki, it feels like in a very real sense, you were among the first people in the world, perhaps outside the military,
sentences.zh: 马利基，感觉在一个非常真实的意义上，你是世界上最早的一批人之一，或许除了军方之外，

sentences.en: to understand that this devastating airstrike was likely carried out by the United States,
sentences.zh: 了解到这次毁灭性的空袭很可能是由美国实施的，

sentences.en: a determination that has now been confirmed preliminarily by an American military investigation.
sentences.zh: 这一结论现在已经得到了美国军事调查的初步证实。

sentences.en: Well, Michael, I'm not sure about that, but we suspected that something went terribly wrong as soon as we started looking at it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，这一点我不敢确定，但我们从一开始着手调查时，就怀疑有什么地方出了严重的问题。

sentences.en: Well, now that this is no longer a suspicion, but something that feels so more or less firm, I want to go back to when this all happened.
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然这不再是一个怀疑，而是变成了一个或多或少已经确定的事实，我想回到这一切发生的时候。

sentences.en: Because the timing of it is important.
sentences.zh: 因为时间节点很重要。

sentences.en: It happened around the same moment that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它发生在大致与美国

sentences.en: and Israel killed Iran's supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 和以色列炸死伊朗最高领袖同时的时刻。

sentences.en: And all the world's eyes were on that.
sentences.zh: 全世界的目光都聚焦在那上面。

sentences.en: And this other airstrike was more or less in parallel, but getting a lot less attention at firSt.
sentences.zh: 而这起空袭基本上是与之同时进行的，但在最初受到的关注要少得多。

sentences.en: But once we all realized what had happened, it was shocking.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们都意识到发生了什么，那就太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: This was an elementary school blown up by a missile, and 175 civilians, mostly children, were killed.
sentences.zh: 这是一所被导弹炸毁的小学，175名平民遇难，其中大多数是儿童。

sentences.en: So I just want to talk for a moment about the scale of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想花一点时间谈谈这场灾难的规模。

sentences.en: Yes, it has devastated Minab, the town where this school was located.
sentences.zh: 是的，它摧毁了米纳卜，也就是这所学校所在的城镇。

sentences.en: Saturday morning is the start of the week and the school week in Iran.
sentences.zh: 周六早晨是伊朗一周以及学校一周的开始。

sentences.en: So school was in session.
sentences.zh: 所以学校正在上课。

sentences.en: The teachers union there said that over 260 students were in the school at the time.
sentences.zh: 当地的教师工会表示，事发时校内有260多名学生。

sentences.en: And most of these kids are age 7 to 12.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子大部分在7到12岁之间。

sentences.en: And according to health officials and the local governor there, most of them were killed in the strike, along with teachers.
sentences.zh: 据卫生官员和当地省长称，他们大多数在空袭中丧生，还有教师们也是如此。

sentences.en: And it really is absolutely horrific what has happened.
sentences.zh: 发生的这一切真的极其骇人听闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's kind of hard to fathom just how many lives were affected by this.
sentences.zh: 简直难以想象有多少人的生活因此受到影响。

sentences.en: It's just an enormous tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这真是一场巨大的悲剧。

sentences.en: It's absolutely hard to understand and to put yourself in their position.
sentences.zh: 绝对让人难以理解，也无法设身处地去感受。

sentences.en: I mean, Manab is a small town in southern Iran.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，米纳卜是伊朗南部的一个小镇。

sentences.en: This has affected the entire community there.
sentences.zh: 这影响了当地的整个社区。

sentences.en: Obviously, the direct relatives, but just the pictures coming out of there, of the streets thronged for the funerals of these children and their teachers are really heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 显然有直系亲属，但从那里传出的画面中，街上挤满了悼念这些孩子和老师的葬礼队伍，真的让人心碎。

sentences.en: You know, there are pictures of mothers throwing themselves over the open coffins of their children as they're saying goodbye to them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，画面中有些母亲扑在孩子们打开的棺木上，向他们作最后的告别。

sentences.en: Scores of coffins brought on a procession through the streets.
sentences.zh: 成群的棺木在街道上进行游行。

sentences.en: You know, people throwing rose petals at them, sharing them with sweets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们向它们抛洒玫瑰花瓣，分发糖果。

sentences.en: There were thousands of people out there.
sentences.zh: 现场有数千人。

sentences.en: And of course, that aerial photograph that many listeners may have seen of the freshly dug graves, a hundred of them in a plot in a cemetery just five miles away from the school.
sentences.zh: 当然，许多听众可能都看过那张航拍照片，照片里是新掘的墓穴，在距离学校仅五英里远的一个墓地里，有一百个墓穴排成一片。

sentences.en: It kind of spoke to the scale of the loss for the community there.
sentences.zh: 这某种程度上说明了当地社区所遭受损失的规模。

sentences.en: And whatever happened here, it was clearly one of the most devastating incidents in an
sentences.zh: 无论这里发生了什么，这显然是美国数十年战争中

sentences.en: American war in decades.
sentences.zh: 最具毁灭性的事件之一。

sentences.en: Which is why you and a team of people on the visual investigations desk here in our newsroom set about trying to get to the bottom of what happened and why it happened.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你和我们新闻室视觉调查组的一群人开始着手弄清到底发生了什么、为什么会发生，

sentences.en: and who was responsible.
sentences.zh: 以及谁应负责。

sentences.en: Can you talk us through what you did from the very beginning to figure that out?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们讲讲你从最初开始是怎么查明这一切的吗？

sentences.en: Well, the incident was flagged to us by our colleagues on international.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这件事是由我们国际部的同事提出来的。

sentences.en: There was a video circulating showing the immediate aftermath of the school building reportedly struck and people rummaging through the rubble outside, smoke billowing from it.
sentences.zh: 当时流传着一段视频，显示据称被击中的学校大楼刚遭袭击后的情景，人们在外部的瓦砾中翻找，浓烟滚滚。

sentences.en: So the first challenge was to verify that the building that we were seeing in videos of the aftermath of the strike was in fact a school and then where it is.
sentences.zh: 所以，第一个挑战是核实我们在袭击后视频中看到的那座建筑确实是一所学校，然后确认它在哪里。

sentences.en: In the video, you can see, you know, bright pastel colored walls with paintings drawn by children.
sentences.zh: 在视频中，你可以看到，你知道的，画有儿童绘画的明亮粉彩墙壁。

sentences.en: Other images were taken from the inside of the building that showed classroom settings and also colorful drawings.
sentences.zh: 其他图像是从建筑内部拍摄的，显示了教室的布置以及五颜六色的画作。

sentences.en: So it looked like a school from the outset.
sentences.zh: 所以一开始它看起来就像是一所学校。

sentences.en: And then secondly, where is it?
sentences.zh: 其次，它在哪里？

sentences.en: We're not in Manab and I never have been there.
sentences.zh: 我们不在米纳卜，我也从未去过那里。

sentences.en: You're, in fact, in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你在爱尔兰。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm outside Limerick in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 对，我在爱尔兰利莫瑞克郊外。

sentences.en: But we've access to satellite imagery, recent satellite imagery of Minab.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以获取卫星图像，获取米纳卜的最新卫星图像。

sentences.en: And I'm able to look around the area and see, you know, find schools that are identified in Google Earth and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 我可以在该区域周围查看，你知道的，找到谷歌地球等软件上标注的学校。

sentences.en: This one actually wasn't marked on Google Earth, but we had heard that it was near a military base.
sentences.zh: 这个实际上在谷歌地球上没有被标记，但我们听说它在一个军事基地附近。

sentences.en: And so by finding the military base, we were able to identify a building and then compare the contours of that building, the size of it,
sentences.zh: 因此，通过找到那个军事基地，我们能够识别出一座建筑，然后将该建筑的轮廓、它的大小、

sentences.en: the trees around it with what we were seeing in the video.
sentences.zh: 它周围的树木与我们在视频中看到的内容进行对比。

sentences.en: And the video was clearly taken at that location and showed the school.
sentences.zh: 视频显然就是在那个地点拍摄的，并且显示的就是那所学校。

sentences.en: And then in the satellite imagery, there were other details that suggested to us that this was a school.
sentences.zh: 在卫星图像中，还有其他细节向我们表明这是一所学校。

sentences.en: You could see a hopscotch area, other play areas marked on the asphalt there.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到跳房子区域，以及沥青路面上标记的其他游乐区。

sentences.en: There's a sports field beside it.
sentences.zh: 旁边还有一个运动场。

sentences.en: And I suppose one of the things was that, you know, one of the most striking things for us was that around the school, amid the rubble,
sentences.zh: 我想其中一点，你知道的，对我们来说最震撼的事情之一是，在学校周围，在瓦砾之中，

sentences.en: you could see school books and small little school bags and backpacks and bright shoes of children who attended the school and then parents rifling through these books to see if it belonged to their loved one.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到课本、小书包、双肩包，以及就读该校的孩子的色彩鲜艳的鞋子，还有父母们在这些书本中仔细翻找，看它们是不是属于自己心爱的人。

sentences.en: Well, from the images that you're describing, it's quite obviously a school with children actively attending it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从你描述的这些影像来看，这显然是一所正在有学生上学的学校。

sentences.en: And so, in theory, that should be obvious to whoever struck it.
sentences.zh: 因此，从理论上讲，对任何发动袭击的人来说，这一点都应该是显而易见的。

sentences.en: And the question is, why wasn't it obvious?
sentences.zh: 问题是，为什么它没有变得显而易见？

sentences.en: Why was it hidden and who did it?
sentences.zh: 为什么它被隐藏了，是谁干的？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, we were also able to determine that it was located beside a naval base of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, which is Iran's most powerful military.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还确定它位于伊斯兰革命卫队的一个海军基地旁边，这是伊朗最强大的军队。

sentences.en: And it was once a part of it we could see in historic satellite imagery that back in 2013 the building that the
sentences.zh: 它曾经是其中的一部分，我们在历史卫星图像中可以看到，早在2013年，

sentences.en: school was in was once encompassed within that broader rectangular military base yeah and then
sentences.zh: 学校所在的建筑曾一度被包围在那个更广泛的矩形军事基地内，是的，然后

sentences.en: by 2016 it was walled off the area was cleared watchtowers were removed public entrances were
sentences.zh: 到2016年，它被围墙隔开，该区域被清理干净，瞭望塔被拆除，公共入口被

sentences.en: opened into it and the ground was cleared for playing areas it was painted all these bright
sentences.zh: 打开通往其中，地面被清理出来作为游乐区，它被漆成了所有这些鲜艳的

sentences.en: colored so it had become, you know, it looked like a school and definitely was used for civilian purposes.
sentences.zh: 颜色，所以它已经变成了，你知道的，它看起来像一所学校，并且绝对是被用于民事目的。

sentences.en: But it was sitting right beside a military site and they were being targeted in these early hours of the war on Iran.
sentences.zh: 但它就坐落在军事基地的旁边，而这些基地正是对伊朗战争头几个小时的目标。

sentences.en: So knowing that at this point you're still very early on in your investigation, what does this suggest exactly to you?
sentences.zh: 既然此时你们的调查还处于早期阶段，这具体向你们暗示了什么？

sentences.en: The fact that 10 years ago it was part of an IRGC military complex.
sentences.zh: 10年前它是伊斯兰革命卫队军事综合体一部分的事实。

sentences.en: It suggested that this might be a massive intelligence failure and somebody identified a school as being a legitimate military target
sentences.zh: 这表明这可能是一次巨大的情报失误，有人将一所学校确定为合法的军事目标，

sentences.en: because we could see from other videos that we also verified that buildings inside in the base had been hit.
sentences.zh: 因为我们可以从我们同样核实过其他视频中看到，基地内部的建筑确实被击中了。

sentences.en: And by timelining out all of those reports, we knew that the school and the base were hit around the same time.
sentences.zh: 通过将所有这些报告按时间排序，我们知道学校和基地大约在同一时间遭到袭击。

sentences.en: So it looked like that opening wave of attacks mistakenly hit the school alongside the military targets in the base.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来第一波攻击在袭击基地内军事目标的同时，误击了学校。

sentences.en: Just to get this out of the way, did anything suggest that even if this has been a school for the past 10 years, that the IRGC was using any part of the
sentences.zh: 为了排除这种可能，有没有任何迹象表明，即使过去10年这是一所学校，伊斯兰革命卫队是否曾将该建筑的

sentences.en: building as a military facility?
sentences.zh: 任何部分用作军事设施？

sentences.en: No, there was no evidence of any military function in that school compound.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有任何证据表明该学校大院内有任何军事功能。

sentences.en: So then how do you go about determining which one of the combatants in this conflict strikes this quite clearly school?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们是如何着手确定这场冲突中的哪一方交战方袭击了这所显然是学校的建筑的？

sentences.en: Because it feels like there's two obvious candidates, the United States or Israel.
sentences.zh: 因为感觉有两个明显的嫌疑人，美国或以色列。

sentences.en: But of course, I'm guessing you can't entirely discount the possibility because this has happened in previous Middle Eastern conflicts and all conflicts that perhaps
sentences.zh: 但当然，我猜你不能完全排除这种可能性，因为在中东以往的冲突和所有冲突中，也许

sentences.en: Iran itself may have misfired and been responsible for this.
sentences.zh: 伊朗自己可能发生了走火并对此负责。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: That was a possibility in the early stages of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这在调查的早期阶段是一种可能性。

sentences.en: And part of it was trying to identify what was hit in the base, how it was hit.
sentences.zh: 其中的一部分工作就是试图确定基地里被击中了什么，它是怎么被击中的。

sentences.en: Were these precise strikes?
sentences.zh: 这些是精确打击吗？

sentences.en: Were there craters littering the base?
sentences.zh: 基地里到处都是弹坑吗？

sentences.en: We couldn't look inside it, and it's not open to the public, and so there were no videos emerging from there.
sentences.zh: 我们无法进去查看，而且它不对公众开放，因此没有视频从那里流传出来。

sentences.en: But we have access to satellite imagery providers, And so we ordered a high-resolution image that would give us a look inside the basin and see what damage was wrought and how.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以接触到卫星图像供应商，因此我们订购了一张高分辨率图像，让我们能够一窥基地内部，看看造成了什么样的破坏以及是如何造成的。

sentences.en: And what did that reveal?
sentences.zh: 那上面显示了什么？

sentences.en: So it showed that several buildings had been destroyed very tidily by precise strikes.
sentences.zh: 它显示几栋建筑被精确打击非常整洁地摧毁了。

sentences.en: And you could even see that there were holes punched through right the center of these large warehouses and buildings inside in the military base.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以看到，在军事基地内部这些大型仓库和建筑的正中心被洞穿了洞。

sentences.en: And the school also was hit.
sentences.zh: 学校也被击中了。

sentences.en: you could see that more than half of it had been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到它的一半以上已被摧毁。

sentences.en: There was a white gaping hole, almost circular in shape.
sentences.zh: 有一个白色的大洞，几乎呈圆形。

sentences.en: And so that indicated that these buildings were hit with precision-guided missiles.
sentences.zh: 这表明这些建筑是用精确制导导弹击中的。

sentences.en: And that's characteristic of Israeli and U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列和美国

sentences.en: capabilities, but it's also characteristic of intelligence planning to take out infrastructure ahead of time in these early strikes hitting the country.
sentences.zh: 能力的特征，但它也是情报规划的特征，即在对该国进行这些早期打击时提前清除基础设施。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So this was not accidental based on what you're seeing at that point and probably not a byproduct of some other strike.
sentences.zh: 所以根据你当时看到的情况，这不是偶然的，也可能不是其他袭击的副产品。

sentences.en: It's not a case, it seems, of shrapnel from one strike hitting the school based on what you just described.
sentences.zh: 根据你刚才的描述，这似乎不是某次袭击的弹片击中学校的情况。

sentences.en: And so it feels like Iran, in your mind, is being taken out of the category of likely candidate.
sentences.zh: 所以在你看来，伊朗似乎被排除了作为嫌疑候选人的可能性。

sentences.en: And so now you're left with Israel and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在只剩下以色列和美国了。

sentences.en: So how do you figure out which of those two are responsible?
sentences.zh: 那么你们是怎么弄清楚这两者中哪一个负责的呢？

sentences.en: Ask them questions.
sentences.zh: 向他们提问。

sentences.en: A spokesperson for the Israel Defense Forces said the day afterwards, on the Sunday, that they weren't operating in the area at that time.
sentences.zh: 以色列国防军的一位发言人在次日也就是周日表示，他们当时没有在该地区活动。

sentences.en: And my colleague Aaron Boxerman questioned U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的同事亚伦·博克斯曼质问了美国

sentences.en: Central Command, and they said their investigation was ongoing, so we didn't get much information from them.
sentences.zh: 中央司令部，他们说他们的调查仍在进行中，所以我们没有从他们那里得到太多信息。

sentences.en: However, on Wednesday of last week...
sentences.zh: 然而，在上周三……

sentences.en: And with that, I turn it over to the chairman.
sentences.zh: 伴随着这些，我将其交由主席。

sentences.zh: 凯恩将军举起了一张地图，显示了美国

sentences.en: and Israeli operations in the first 100 hours of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 和以色列在冲突前100小时内的行动。

sentences.en: And using a laser pointer, he swung by the south of Iran and he said the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他用激光笔扫过伊朗南部，并表示美国

sentences.en: was primarily striking targets in the south.
sentences.zh: 主要在南部打击目标。

sentences.en: ballistic missile capabilities as well as integrated air defense capabilities along the southern axis.
sentences.zh: 沿南部轴线的弹道导弹能力以及综合防空能力。

sentences.en: Along the northern axis,
sentences.zh: 沿着北部轴线，

sentences.en: Israel and the Israeli Air Force has predominantly been working...
sentences.zh: 以色列和以色列空军主要在……

sentences.en: And Israel was operating in the north and the weSt.
sentences.zh: 以色列在北部和西部进行行动。

sentences.en: And even on that map, there was a strike location and that strike location is in the area around Manab.
sentences.zh: 甚至在那张地图上，也有一个打击地点，那个打击地点就在米纳卜周边地区。

sentences.en: So from what Israeli officials were saying and what General Dan Cain was saying and based on the type of weaponry used, the evidence was pointing more and more towards a U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，从以色列官员所说的话以及丹·凯恩将军所说的话来看，并根据所使用的武器类型，证据越来越指向美国

sentences.en: strike.
sentences.zh: 发动的袭击。

sentences.en: Right, because the school is in the south of Iran.
sentences.zh: 对，因为学校在伊朗南部。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And then we obtained this really critical piece of video evidence.
sentences.zh: 然后我们获得了这件非常关键的视频证据。

sentences.en: It was filmed across the street from the naval base at a construction site.
sentences.zh: 它是在海军基地对面的一个建筑工地拍摄的。

sentences.en: And it shows a missile coming in, not hitting the school, but hitting the base.
sentences.zh: 画面显示一枚导弹飞来，没有击中学校，而是击中了基地。

sentences.en: And in the milliseconds before impact, you can see the silhouette of the weapon against the blue sky, which opens the possibility of identifying what type of weapon this is.
sentences.zh: 在撞击前的几毫秒里，你可以看到武器在蓝天背景下的剪影，这让我们有可能识别出这是一种什么武器。

sentences.en: Now Trevor Ball who's a weapons expert with the research group Bellingcat he identified it as a Tomahawk missile and we also did
sentences.zh: 现在，Bellingcat研究小组的武器专家特雷弗·鲍尔将其鉴定为“战斧”导弹，我们

sentences.en: we spoke to other weapons experts and my colleague John Ismay who himself is a weapons expert analysed it and based on the dimensions and the design of it
sentences.zh: 也采访了其他武器专家，我的同事约翰·伊斯梅他本人也是一位武器专家，对此进行了分析，根据它的尺寸和设计

sentences.en: it was clearly a Tomahawk cruise missile and that's significant because the only party in this war with tomahawks is the United States.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一枚“战斧”巡航导弹，这一点很重要，因为在这场战争中，只有美国一方拥有“战斧”导弹。

sentences.en: And so the evidence is really pointing towards U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，种种证据确实直指美国

sentences.en: culpability.
sentences.zh: 难辞其咎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A missile strike and a tomahawk missile likely destroyed that Iranian girls' school.
sentences.zh: 一场导弹袭击，一枚“战斧”导弹很可能摧毁了那所伊朗女子学校。

sentences.en: So will the Americans, will the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国人，美国

sentences.en: accept any responsibility for that strike?
sentences.zh: 会为这次袭击承担任何责任吗？

sentences.en: And then at a news conference on Monday,
sentences.zh: 然后在周一的一次新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: President Trump posited the idea that Iran fired the tomahawk.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统提出了一个观点，即是伊朗发射了这枚“战斧”导弹。

sentences.en: It's used by, you know, it's sold and used by other countries, you know that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这被其他国家使用，它被其他国家出售和使用，你知道的。

sentences.en: and whether it's Iran, who also has some tomahawks, they wish they had more.
sentences.zh: 不管是伊朗，他们也拥有一些“战斧”，他们希望拥有更多。

sentences.en: Once again, despite all the information we have.
sentences.zh: 再一次，尽管我们掌握了所有这些信息。

sentences.en: Yeah, we don't know where he's getting his information from.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们不知道他的信息是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: And our colleague, Sean McCreech, who covers the White House for The Times,
sentences.zh: 我们的同事肖恩·麦克里奇为《泰晤士报》报道白宫新闻，

sentences.en: is there and asks President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他当时也在现场，并向特朗普总统提问。

sentences.en: You just suggested that Iran somehow got its hands on a tomahawk and bombed its own elementary school on the first day of the war.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚暗示伊朗不知怎么弄到了一枚“战斧”导弹，并在战争的第一天轰炸了它自己的小学。

sentences.en: But you're the only person in your government saying this.
sentences.zh: 但你是你政府中唯一这么说的人。

sentences.en: Even your defense secretary wouldn't say that when he was asked, standing over your shoulder on your plane on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 甚至你的国防部长在周六于飞机上站在你身后被问及此事时，也没有这么说。

sentences.en: Why are you the only person saying this?
sentences.zh: 为什么你是唯一一个这么说的人？

sentences.en: Because I just don't know enough about it.
sentences.zh: 因为我对这事了解得还不够多。

sentences.en: I think it's something that I was told is under investigation.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我被告知正在调查的事情。

sentences.en: And President Trump says, well, we're waiting for the results of an investigation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统说，好吧，我们在等待调查结果。

sentences.en: And if the investigation finds that it's us, I'm willing to live with that.
sentences.zh: 如果调查发现是我们干的，我愿意接受这个结果。

sentences.en: But I will certainly, whatever the report shows, I'm willing to live with that report.
sentences.zh: 但无论报告显示什么，我肯定都愿意接受那份报告。

sentences.en: Which is, in a couple of days, precisely what starts to happen.
sentences.zh: 而这正是几天后开始发生的事情。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Officials that our colleagues in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 我们在华盛顿特区的同事

sentences.en: spoke to who are close to the investigation say that the preliminary findings find that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 采访了接近调查的官员，他们表示初步调查结果显示美国

sentences.en: is responsible for the school strike.
sentences.zh: 对学校袭击事件负有责任。

sentences.en: Well, Maliki, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，马利基，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague Julian Barnes on exactly what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我的同事朱利安·巴恩斯将带来关于美国

sentences.en: government investigation has found.
sentences.zh: 政府调查具体发现的详细报道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏部门拼字游戏“Connections”的作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的奇特感知。

sentences.en: Julian, you and a team of our colleagues at The Times broke the story on Wednesday morning that a preliminary investigation by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 朱利安，你和《泰晤士报》的一组同事在周三上午独家爆料称，美国

sentences.en: government has determined that the United
sentences.zh: 政府的一项初步调查确定，美国

sentences.en: States military was responsible for the airstrike on this elementary school that we have been talking about with Maliki.
sentences.zh: 军方对我们刚才与马利基讨论的那所小学的空袭负有责任。

sentences.en: So tell us what you've come to understand about that investigation.
sentences.zh: 那么，请给我们讲讲你们对这项调查的了解。

sentences.en: Well, what we've learned is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们了解到的是，一直在调查此事的美国

sentences.en: officials who have been looking into this have come to the conclusion that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 官员们已经得出结论，美国

sentences.en: was responsible.
sentences.zh: 负有责任。

sentences.en: The military took old information and used it to make the targets on the day of the strike, and they did not update the data, they did not verify it,
sentences.zh: 军方使用了旧的信息来制定袭击当日的目标，他们没有更新数据，没有进行核实，

sentences.en: and realize what we've all come to know now, that this became a school a decade or more ago.
sentences.zh: 也没有意识到我们现在都已知道的情况——这里在十年前或更早以前就已经变成了一所学校。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And 10 years is a very long time ago.
sentences.zh: 10年前是很久以前了。

sentences.en: So you're suggesting that whether it was maps or coordinates, what exactly was it that they were using that was this outdated?
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，无论是地图还是坐标，他们到底在用什么才会这么过时？

sentences.en: So the Defense Intelligence Agency is one of the agencies that gathers information and they do it from maps and they do it from other pieces of data and they put it into a big database that they will push forward.
sentences.zh: 国防情报局是收集信息的机构之一，他们通过地图和其他数据获取信息，并将其输入一个大型数据库，然后推进使用。

sentences.en: As basically a target liSt.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是作为一个目标列表。

sentences.en: As a target list or what you will draw your target list from, right?
sentences.zh: 作为一个目标列表，或者说你是从哪里提取你的目标列表的，对吧？

sentences.en: Making a target is a complicated process.
sentences.zh: 制定一个目标是一个复杂的过程。

sentences.en: And that's the next stage of the military investigation to figure out, did the verification not take place?
sentences.zh: 这也是军事调查的下一个阶段要弄清楚的问题，核实工作当时究竟有没有进行？

sentences.en: Did it fail to reveal the truth?
sentences.zh: 它是否未能揭示真相？

sentences.en: Where did that process break down?
sentences.zh: 那个流程是在哪个环节出了问题？

sentences.en: Because there's old data that's entered all the time and there are safety nets that are meant to catch it.
sentences.zh: 因为总会有旧数据被录入，而且原本有旨在拦截的安全网。

sentences.en: But they didn't catch it in this place.
sentences.zh: 但这次它们没有拦截下来。

sentences.en: I do think we should linger for a moment on how seemingly straightforward verification would have been.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为我们应该停留片刻，想想核实工作本来是多么的简单直接。

sentences.en: And I say that because our colleague Maliki used commercially available satellite photos to determine that this was a school.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因为我们的同事马利基利用商业可得的卫星照片就确定了这是一所学校。

sentences.en: And that's not to mention the fact that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 更不用说美国

sentences.en: has drones and planes capable of monitoring a place like a school from very far away and determining, even if the original data was 10 years old,
sentences.zh: 拥有能够从很远的地方监控像学校这样地方的无人机和飞机，并能确定，即使原始数据是10年前的，

sentences.en: who's coming in and out of a building.
sentences.zh: 谁在进出一栋建筑。

sentences.en: And that work might not have taken very long.
sentences.zh: 而且这项工作可能不需要很长时间。

sentences.en: And so it gets hard to understand how the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就很难理解为什么美国

sentences.en: military could only be reliant on 10-year-old data without doing any of the very simple forms of follow-up that would have shown that it was out of date.
sentences.zh: 军方会完全依赖10年前的数据，却不做任何非常简单的后续核实工作，而这些工作本可以显示数据已经过时。

sentences.en: The system for picking targets and verifying targets is very complex.
sentences.zh: 挑选目标和核实目标的系统非常复杂。

sentences.en: There is supposed to be a double check.
sentences.zh: 本该有双重检查。

sentences.en: There is supposed to be a triple check.
sentences.zh: 本该有三重检查。

sentences.en: You get data from the Defense Intelligence Agency.
sentences.zh: 你从国防情报局获取数据。

sentences.en: You cross check it with satellite imagery from the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency, the people who look at the satellite pictures.
sentences.zh: 你将其与国家地理空间情报局（即负责查看卫星图片的人）的卫星图像进行交叉比对。

sentences.en: You have all kinds of computer programs that are supposed to help you, the analyst, do this.
sentences.zh: 你有各种各样的计算机程序来帮助你——分析师来做这件事。

sentences.en: You have AI that's supposed to review it.
sentences.zh: 你有用来进行审查的人工智能。

sentences.en: You have your own expertise.
sentences.zh: 你有你自己的专业知识。

sentences.en: And then the intelligence officer is supposed to take it and then give it to the operations officer who is hopefully doing a last check that it is what they say it is.
sentences.zh: 然后情报军官应该将它拿过去，再交给作战军官，希望作战军官能做最后一次检查，确认它确实就是他们所说的那样。

sentences.en: There are levels built into the system that are supposed to catch this,
sentences.zh: 系统内部内置了旨在拦截此类问题的层级，

sentences.en: but we are in an era when they want the military to move faSt. They want the military to be willing to break things.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在处于这样一个时代：他们希望军方行动迅速。他们希望军方愿意打破常规。

sentences.en: And the system of checks broke down.
sentences.zh: 结果审查系统崩溃了。

sentences.en: We do not fully know how and when, but the bottom line is 10-year-old data was used and it resulted in a catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 我们并不完全知道是如何以及何时崩溃的，但底线是使用了10年前的数据，并导致了一场灾难。

sentences.en: I want to zero in on something you said, because it does feel important.
sentences.zh: 我想把焦点集中在你所说的一点上，因为这确实很重要。

sentences.en: We now have a defense secretary in Pete Hegseth who routinely talks about how cumbersome old processes were, is dismissive of the old rules, and very focused on lethality.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的国防部长皮特·海格塞斯经常谈到旧流程多么繁琐，对旧规则不屑一顾，并且非常专注于致命性。

sentences.en: I mean, he literally said, no more rules of engagement.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他直言不讳地说，不再有什么交战规则。

sentences.en: So is there an understanding, and perhaps at this point it's an assumption rather than a determination, that that ethos played a role here?
sentences.zh: 那么，人们是否有一种理解——也许目前这还是一种假设而非定论——即这种精神在这里发挥了作用？

sentences.en: So this is the question I am asking.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我正在问的问题。

sentences.en: This is the question my colleagues are asking.
sentences.zh: 这也是我的同事们在问的问题。

sentences.en: It's the obvious question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个显而易见的问题。

sentences.en: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has been saying that these rules are too cumbersome, that they make a weak, woke military, right?
sentences.zh: 国防部长皮特·海格塞斯一直在说这些规则太繁琐了，它们造就了一支软弱、过于讲究政治正确的军队，对吧？

sentences.en: So this is the environment that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是美国

sentences.en: military is operating in.
sentences.zh: 军方运作的环境。

sentences.en: That said, we do not have reporting that the elimination of the civilian casualty rules played a part here.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我们并没有报道表明消除平民伤亡规则在这里起到了作用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm curious, Julian, what you think, based on your many years covering these kinds of incidents, what accountability might look like in a case like this?
sentences.zh: 朱利安，我很想知道，基于你多年来报道此类事件的经验，你认为在这样的事件中问责会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Do you think that it's likely anyone will be fired for this?
sentences.zh: 你认为会有人因此被解雇吗？

sentences.en: Will there be any effort to hold individuals or an entire chain of command responsible?
sentences.zh: 是否会有任何努力来追究个人或整个指挥链的责任？

sentences.en: Will there be any effort to compensate the families of those killed?
sentences.zh: 是否会有任何努力来赔偿遇难者家属？

sentences.en: I mean, compensation is a very inadequate word, given that we're talking about small children who were killed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，“赔偿”是一个非常苍白的词，考虑到我们谈论的是被杀害的幼小儿童。

sentences.en: But what do you think happens as a result of this?
sentences.zh: 但你认为这会带来什么结果？

sentences.en: In a different administration, this would have been handled in the complete opposite way, right?
sentences.zh: 在另一届政府中，这件事的处理方式会完全相反，对吧？

sentences.en: We would be having a president not blaming the opponent.
sentences.zh: 我们不会看到一个总统去指责对手。

sentences.en: We would not have a president rushing to judgment.
sentences.zh: 我们不会有一个急于下结论的总统。

sentences.en: And then you'd have the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后你会看到美国

sentences.en: looking to potentially make an apology, potentially to do compensation to the families.
sentences.zh: 寻求可能进行道歉，可能对家属进行赔偿。

sentences.en: In Afghanistan, there was regular compensation when civilians were wrongly targeted or when there was a civilian casualty in an otherwise correct military operation.
sentences.zh: 在阿富汗，当平民被错误作为目标，或者在其他方面正确的军事行动中出现平民伤亡时，通常会有赔偿。

sentences.en: But this is a very different administration.
sentences.zh: 但这届政府非常不同。

sentences.en: They do not like to apologize.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢道歉。

sentences.en: This is not the kind of thing that gets you fired.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种会让你被解雇的事情。

sentences.en: On the other hand, we still have a professional military.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我们仍然有一支职业军队。

sentences.en: They operate on our ethos.
sentences.zh: 他们按照我们的精神行事。

sentences.en: They do investigations.
sentences.zh: 他们会进行调查。

sentences.en: And so there will be a measure of lessons learned, accountability.
sentences.zh: 因此，将会有吸取教训和问责的措施。

sentences.en: The military will try to prevent this from happening again.
sentences.zh: 军方将努力防止这种情况再次发生。

sentences.en: What we know is that President Trump, in response to a question from our colleague
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，特朗普总统在回应我们的同事

sentences.en: Sean McCreish, said that he would go along with the findings of this investigation.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·麦克里奇的问题时表示，他将顺从这项调查的结果。

sentences.en: And so I'm curious, what, if anything, he or the White House has said about what you have all learned this investigation preliminarily has found?
sentences.zh: 因此我很想知道，他和白宫对于你们大家得知的调查初步发现，到底说了些什么（如果有的话）？

sentences.en: Well, Carolyn Levitt, the press secretary, in her statement to us, you know, emphasized that these are preliminary findings.
sentences.zh: 嗯，新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特在给我们的声明中，你知道的，强调这些只是初步调查结果。

sentences.en: But later in the day...
sentences.zh: 但在当天晚些时候……

sentences.en: As President Trump was walking to Marine One, he stopped to talk to the reporters there.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统走向“海军陆战队一号”时，他停下来与那里的记者交谈。

sentences.en: And one of them shouted out a question about our story.
sentences.zh: 其中一人大声喊出一个关于我们报道的问题。

sentences.en: A new report shows, a new report says that the military investigation has found that the United States dropped his tool in Iran.
sentences.zh: 一份新报告显示，一份新报告称，军事调查发现美国在伊朗投下了炸弹。

sentences.en: As commander-in-chief, you take responsibility for that.
sentences.zh: 作为三军统帅，你对此承担责任吗？

sentences.en: That is what?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You could see him take a step back.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到他往后退了一步。

sentences.en: I don't know, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我不知道。

sentences.en: And then he said, I don't know about that.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我不知道这事。

sentences.en: It was a kind of a distancing from the story.
sentences.zh: 这是一种与这篇报道保持距离的做法。

sentences.en: So I don't know if we can expect Donald Trump to engage with these findings or the final military investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道我们是否能指望唐纳德·特朗普去理会这些调查结果或最终的军事调查。

sentences.en: It is an uncomfortable subject.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人尴尬的主题。

sentences.en: It is not the kind of example of winning that he wants to talk about.
sentences.zh: 这不是他想要谈论的那种胜利的范例。

sentences.en: Julian, you had mentioned a few moments ago Afghanistan, and the reality is that what happened here, the idea that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 朱利安，你刚才提到了阿富汗，现实情况是，这里发生的事情——美国犯下错误并导致平民死亡的想法——并不是一个新现象。

sentences.en: would make a mistake and that it would kill civilians, it's not a new phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中经常讨论这一点。

sentences.en: We talk about it a lot on the show.
sentences.zh: 目前美国主要进行的战争，都是从空中展开的。

sentences.en: War right now, as the United States largely conducts it, is from the air.
sentences.zh: 它是通过无人机或军舰从很远的地方发射导弹来进行的，这就是我们认为这所学校发生的情况。

sentences.en: And it's through drones or warships firing missiles from very far away, which is what we think happened in the case of this school.
sentences.zh: 这种做法的想法是将美国士兵与地面作战带来的危险隔离开来。

sentences.en: And the idea is that it insulates American soldiers from harm that would come from being on the ground.
sentences.zh: 但风险现在已经非常明显了。

sentences.en: But the risks are now very plain.
sentences.zh: 而且作为军队，我们相当定期地杀死平民，因为我们离目标不够近，无法弄清楚谁在那里。

sentences.en: And we somewhat regularly, as a military, kill civilians because we aren't close enough to the targets to understand who's there.
sentences.zh: 几年前尤其如此，当时我们

sentences.en: That was especially true a few years back, and we We did an episode about it when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 制作过一期关于美国（的节目）。

sentences.en: military killed a man in Afghanistan who we believed was a suspect of an attack when, in fact, he was an aid worker and we killed nine members
sentences.zh: 军方在阿富汗杀死了一名我们认为是袭击嫌疑人的男子，而事实上，他是一名救援人员，我们还杀害了他

sentences.en: of his family, including his seven children.
sentences.zh: 家里的九名成员，其中包括他的七个孩子。

sentences.en: Is this form of modern American warfare just going to be far more error-prone?
sentences.zh: 这种现代美军的作战方式，是不是会变得更容易出错？

sentences.en: No matter what war you're in, there are going to be errors.
sentences.zh: 无论你卷入什么战争，都免不了会出现错误。

sentences.en: There are going to be human errors.
sentences.zh: 总会有人的失误。

sentences.en: There are going to be machine errors.
sentences.zh: 总会有机器的故障。

sentences.en: You can't get away from mistakes in warfare.
sentences.zh: 战争中的失误是无法避免的。

sentences.en: But what you say is true, right?
sentences.zh: 但你说的没错，对吧？

sentences.en: If this was a different kind of war, we would have had a spotter on the ground.
sentences.zh: 如果这是一场不同类型的战争，我们就会在地面上部署观察员。

sentences.en: They are that ultimate check.
sentences.zh: 他们是最后的终极核查机制。

sentences.en: And that person would have said, wait, there are schoolchildren here.
sentences.zh: 而且这个人会说，等等，这里有小学生。

sentences.en: There are playgrounds here.
sentences.zh: 这里有游乐场。

sentences.en: This is not the right target.
sentences.zh: 这不是正确的目标。

sentences.en: And when you are at a remove, hundreds of miles away, firing tomahawk missiles, making orders from half a world away in Tampa, Florida.
sentences.zh: 而当你抽身事外，在几百英里之外，发射战斧巡航导弹，从半个地球外的佛罗里达州坦帕市下达指令时。

sentences.en: Like, you are at a remove from the battlefield, and that does create an opportunity for these kind of errors.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，你与战场保持了一定距离，这确实为这类错误创造了机会。

sentences.en: Just to end our conversation here, Julian, it is very hard to say what will ultimately define any war, and we are now a week and a half into this one.
sentences.zh: 为了结束我们今天的对话，朱利安，很难说最终会是什么来定义一场战争，我们现在这场战争才打了一个半星期。

sentences.en: A lot could happen, but it feels like a mistake of this magnitude.
sentences.zh: 可能会发生很多事，但感觉像这样规模的错误。

sentences.en: with the death of so many innocent children feels like it will be remembered on all sides as a signature moment of this war.
sentences.zh: 伴随着如此多无辜儿童的死亡，让人觉得各方都会将此铭记为这场战争的标志性时刻。

sentences.en: How do you think that this mistake, this tragedy, this killing of all of these children at this elementary school in the early hours of this war is going to be remembered?
sentences.zh: 你认为这场战争初期的这次失误、这场悲剧、这场在这所小学里对所有这些儿童的屠杀，将会如何被人铭记？

sentences.en: When you think about this war, You know that no matter what policy goals are achieved in this war, the death of the supreme leader,
sentences.zh: 当你想到这场战争时，你知道无论在这场战争中实现什么政策目标，最高领袖的死，

sentences.en: the weakening of the Iranian regime or the elimination potentially of its nuclear program, whatever is to come, this war is still going to be remembered,
sentences.zh: 伊朗政权的削弱，或其核计划可能被彻底消除，无论未来如何，这场战争仍然会被人们记住，

sentences.en: defined by this mistake as well.
sentences.zh: 并被这个错误所定义。

sentences.en: It's too big an error.
sentences.zh: 这是一个太大的错误。

sentences.en: It's too big a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这是一场太大的悲剧。

sentences.en: And if we think back on other American wars, we do think of the things that go wrong, right?
sentences.zh: 如果我们回想美国其他的战争，我们确实会想起那些出错的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: If we go back to Vietnam, we think of the My Lai massacre.
sentences.zh: 如果我们回看越南战争，我们会想起美莱村大屠杀。

sentences.en: We think of the use of napalm that killed children.
sentences.zh: 我们会想起使用导致儿童死亡的凝固汽油弹。

sentences.en: If we go to the Iraq war, we think of Abu Ghraib and the abuse of prisoners there.
sentences.zh: 如果我们回顾伊拉克战争，我们会想起阿布格莱布监狱及其对囚犯的虐待。

sentences.en: We think of that terrible military mistake and the consequences it had.
sentences.zh: 我们会想起那个可怕的军事失误以及它所带来的后果。

sentences.en: And no matter what is to come in this war in Iran, the killing of the schoolchildren, the mistaken targeting of a school by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 无论这场对伊朗的战争未来如何，美军对这所学校的错误瞄准、杀害了这些小学生，

sentences.en: military is going to color how we look at it.
sentences.zh: 都将为我们如何看待这场战争涂上底色。

sentences.en: Well, Julian, I appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，朱利安，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On the 12th day of the war, Israel's bombardment of Lebanon intensified.
sentences.zh: 在战争的第十二天，以色列对黎巴嫩的轰炸加剧了。

sentences.en: Israel's attacks aimed at Hezbollah, which has fired rockets into Israel in support of Iran,
sentences.zh: 据黎巴嫩官员称，以色列旨在打击真主党的袭击——真主党为支持伊朗向以色列发射了火箭弹——

sentences.en: has killed more than 600 people and displaced more than 800,000, according to Lebanese officials.
sentences.zh: 已造成600多人死亡，80多万人流离失所。

sentences.en: In Iran, the Times reports that the country's new supreme leader,
sentences.zh: 在伊朗，《泰晤士报》报道称，该国的新最高领袖

sentences.en: Mushtaba Khamenei, has yet to make a public appearance, in part because he was wounded during the opening days of attacks by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊尚未公开露面，部分原因是他在此前美以开战初期的袭击中受伤。

sentences.en: and Israel.
sentences.zh: 和以色列。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, with the Strait of Hormuz still closed to most shipping, oil prices rose again on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，霍尔木兹海峡仍然对大多数航运关闭，周三油价再次上涨。

sentences.en: That was despite a pledge by the 32 countries of the International Energy Agency to release 400 million barrels of oil from their strategic reserve.
sentences.zh: 尽管国际能源署的32个成员国承诺从其战略储备中释放4亿桶石油。

sentences.en: It was the largest release in the agency's history.
sentences.zh: 这是该机构历史上最大规模的释放。

sentences.en: It was the latest economic disruption from the war.
sentences.zh: 这是战争带来的最新经济动荡。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Iran struck three commercial ships around the Strait of Hormuz, and several major banks, including Citi and HSBC,
sentences.zh: 周三，伊朗袭击了霍尔木兹海峡周边的三艘商船，包括花旗银行和汇丰银行在内的几家主要银行

sentences.en: said they would temporarily close their offices in the Persian Gulf.
sentences.zh: 表示，出于对员工安全的担忧，他们将暂时关闭在波斯湾的办事处。

sentences.en: out of fear for the safety of their workers.
sentences.zh: 出于对工人安全的担忧。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Shannon Lynn and Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由香农·林恩和迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willans and Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 由帕特里夏·威兰斯和佩奇·考维特剪辑。

sentences.en: Contains music by Rowan Evisto and Sophia Landman.
sentences.zh: 包含罗恩·埃维斯托和索菲亚·兰德man的音乐。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由 Wonderly 创作。

sentences.en: This episode was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由阿丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了（上台了）一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我，萨拉·科尼格，将为您讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
